description: Run the BMP388, OLED, HLK-LD2450, and HC-SR04 concurrently on one ESP32-C3 node.

demonstration_steps.expected: The profile is accepted and four device tasks enter the running state.
BMP388 pressure and temperature samples reach the OLED every 2000 ms.
Parsed target data appears on the OLED and monitoring output.
The BMP388 sampling period changes without rebuilding the firmware.
The HC-SR04 task stops without affecting the other device tasks.
An I²C timeout is published to system health and shown on the OLED.
